endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Requires admin bearer auth and returns the configured multi-source external collection scheduler cadence and the in-memory status snapshot for the active backend process without changing the public /api/health contract.

Admin-only manual operation endpoint. Fetches configured official external policy sources, upserts external_source_records, promotes public-eligible records into policies (including local_half_trip active/scheduled rows), maps source HTTP 404/410 to per-source source_unavailable, treats traffic_benefit as optional legacy, and returns per-source success/error details without exposing secrets.

Requires admin bearer auth, summarizes official external benefit records from external_source_records, and includes a recommendationPreview generated by the existing region recommendation service without performing a live network fetch.

Validates required terms/privacy agreements, sends verification email, and stores pending signup with agreement metadata only after email delivery succeeds; does not create users until /api/auth/signup/complete.
Validates a pending signup token and returns the verified email without creating a user or setting a refresh cookie.
Consumes a valid pending signup token with a password, creates the user, returns AuthResponse, and sets the refresh cookie.

Returns available=false when an active user with the same email exists. Withdrawn users are ignored because withdrawal anonymizes users.email to withdrawn-{id}-{timestamp}@withdrawn.local; the original email can sign up again.
Rotates a valid refresh cookie into a new AuthResponse. If the token's user is withdrawn or otherwise inactive, revokes that refresh token and returns 401 without issuing a new token.

Requires an active authenticated user with password_hash. Verifies currentPassword, updates users.password_hash, revokes the user's existing refresh tokens, forbids extra request fields, returns 400 for passwordless accounts, and returns 401 for missing auth, withdrawn users, or wrong current password.

Requires an active authenticated user. Password users must send only password; OAuth-only/passwordless users must send only confirmationPhrase='탈퇴합니다'. Soft-withdraws the user by setting users.withdrawn_at and HMAC users.withdrawn_email_hash, anonymizing email to withdrawn-{id}-{timestamp}@withdrawn.local, changing nickname to 탈퇴한 사용자 #{id}, clearing password_hash/profile preferences/social_accounts, revoking refresh tokens, clearing the refresh cookie, preserving related rows and password_reset_tokens, rejecting extra fields, and allowing the original email to re-sign up because active lookups ignore withdrawn users.

Always returns requested=true for valid email shape. Stores only a SHA-256 reset token hash and sends SMTP only for active users with password_hash; nonexistent, passwordless/OAuth-only, and withdrawn users get the same response without token creation.

Validates the hashed token, rejects expired/used/unknown tokens, rejects tokens whose user is withdrawn or passwordless, updates users.password_hash, marks the token used, and revokes existing refresh tokens. Existing password_reset_tokens rows remain stored across soft withdrawal but fail closed at confirm time.

endpoints.requiredBehavior: Sets OAuth state HttpOnly cookie and redirects to the Kakao authorization URL. Unsupported providers return 404 and missing provider config returns 503.
Sets OAuth state HttpOnly cookie and redirects to the Google OpenID Connect authorization URL. Unsupported providers return 404 and missing provider config returns 503.

On existing active social user or verified same-email active user link success, validates code/state, links social_accounts as needed, sets the refresh cookie, clears the OAuth state cookie, and redirects to frontend /oauth/callback?redirect={safePath}. Withdrawn users are fail-closed because social account and same-email lookups use active-user paths only. For a new social account, does not create a user or set refresh cookie; creates pending_social_signups and redirects to frontend /signup/social-agreement?token={token}&redirect={safePath}. Same-email auto-link requires verified provider email; Google requires email_verified=true, while Kakao without usable verified email may use kakao_{providerId}@oauth.local in the pending signup. On terminal failure, does not set a refresh cookie, clears the OAuth state cookie where possible, and redirects to frontend /oauth/callback?error={access_denied|invalid_state|provider_unavailable|profile_unavailable|email_policy}&redirect={safePath} without exposing provider error_description.

endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Reads an active pending_social_signups row by token hash and returns display-only provider/email/nickname metadata plus the persisted safe redirect path without creating a user.

Validates active pending social signup token and current required agreements, creates users/social_accounts only after agreement, deletes the pending row, returns AuthResponse, and sets the refresh cookie.
Requires bearer auth for an active user. Withdrawn users are rejected by get_current_user before this DTO is returned.
Requires bearer auth and returns a non-persisted random nickname suggestion.
Requires bearer auth, trims the nickname, validates length 2-20, and updates users.nickname.

Updates users.preferred_regions, users.travel_style, and users.travel_budget, then marks onboarding_completed true. Explicit null or an empty preferredRegions array clears the corresponding unset preference. Unknown extra request fields are rejected with 422.
Marks onboarding complete without persisting profile field selections and records that the profile step was explicitly skipped.

Ranks public recommendation-eligible external_source_records rows by active fresh regional policy count, ending-soon count, explicit KRW value, style as a non-overriding tie breaker, and profile region only as the final tie breaker. preferredRegions accepts up to three 17-sido values and, when provided, reserves one candidate per selected region before score-order fill; nationwide records are included only as fallback when regional candidates are fewer than limit. local_half_trip records count directly, while stay_discount records are expanded from raw_payload.eligibleAreas into regional alias candidates so the canonical stay policy is not counted as an extra +1. Legacy regional_benefit and traffic_benefit evidence is excluded from public recommendation scoring.

Returns official-benefit Policy DTOs from DB policies only. local_half_trip active/scheduled rows and active/fresh stay_discount external_source_records are promoted into policies by the collection normalization service. local_half_trip keeps backward-compatible travelmonth-{externalSourceRecordId} slugs and formats titles with bracketed municipality prefixes such as `[합천] 대한민국 반값여행 지원`; confirmed digital tourism card seed policies remain separate from local_half_trip copy and official URLs, using bracketed titles such as `[해남] 디지털 관광주민증 혜택`. stay_discount keeps one canonical promoted policy internally, but public list/search/recommendation responses hide that canonical row and project raw_payload.eligibleAreas into stay-discount-{sidoSlug}-{citySlug} regional aliases; alias rows format titles with city prefixes such as `[고성] ...`, return broad `region` values such as `강원`/`경남`, use cleaned summary/amount/requirements copy for public stay-discount detail display, are actionable, and omit/null actionStatus. regional_benefit is legacy summary evidence for the same half-trip program and is hidden/excluded from public policy promotion, recommendation, and raw detail fallback; traffic_benefit is optional legacy source evidence and is not promoted into public policies. local_half_trip records that are ended, unknown-status, or stale are hidden from public policy lists by setting policies.status to hidden when a promoted policy exists. sourceType remains in the DTO for compatibility/internal diagnostics, but user-facing UI must not expose internal/external wording and all exposed normalized policies share save/trip behavior. Policy category is a benefit/source type; TravelMonth records derive category from source URL/sourceCategory and do not use travelStyles for category filtering. Hidden policies are excluded by backend query and public Policy.status is not exposed in v1. structuredDetail is optional user-detail JSON with benefits/conditions/periods/links/documents/notices sections; it is screen-ready policies.structured_detail data, not raw external_source_records.raw_payload, link URLs exposed to users are limited to http/https, and missing/empty sections preserve existing section-level fallback rendering.

Legacy dgtour-{city}-{n} detail slugs redirect with 307 to the promoted travelmonth-{externalSourceRecordId} local_half_trip policy when a matching municipality exists, preventing old pre-normalization detail pages from reappearing; active dgtour policies explicitly classified as separate digital tourism card benefits do not redirect and keep bracketed titles such as `[해남] 디지털 관광주민증 혜택`. travelmonth-{externalSourceRecordId} slugs resolve normalized TravelMonth/local_half_trip policies with bracketed municipality title prefixes such as `[합천] 대한민국 반값여행 지원`, and stay-discount-{sidoSlug}-{citySlug} aliases resolve the canonical stay_discount policy. stay_discount alias detail echoes the requested alias slug, formats title with a city prefix such as `[고성] ...`, returns broad `region` values such as `강원`/`경남`, returns cleaned summary/amount/requirements copy, while save/remove/trip mutations persist canonical Policy.id and echo the request alias in mutation responses. A temporary raw external_source_records fallback may resolve active/fresh local_half_trip and stay_discount detail during migration gaps, but regional_benefit, traffic_benefit, and non-active/non-fresh records do not resolve through the public fallback. Hidden policies return 404 from the public detail route. structuredDetail is optional user-detail JSON with benefits/conditions/periods/links/documents/notices sections; it is screen-ready policies.structured_detail data, not raw external_source_records.raw_payload, link URLs exposed to users are limited to http/https, and missing/empty sections preserve existing section-level fallback rendering.
Requires bearer auth and returns current user's saved policies.
Requires bearer auth and returns distinct policies linked to trips owned by or shared with the current user.
Requires bearer auth and stores user_saved_policies idempotently.
Requires bearer auth and removes user_saved_policies idempotently.

endpoints.dynamicPolicyRegionBehavior: When a policy locality is not covered by the static catalog, the API may return an opaque dynamic single-city id policy-region:{urlencoded-sido}:{urlencoded-city}; clients pass it unchanged as travelAreaId.

endpoints.dbModeTripIdPolicy: The API returns numeric trip ids as strings and accepts only numeric string trip handles.
endpoints.actualParticipantDisplayBehavior: Trip list UI must display actual participants from people/real owner-member data, not legacy participantCount.
endpoints.dbModeRecommendationBehavior: recommendedPolicies only includes policies whose municipality/city matches the trip destination. Province-only 광역 matches are not sufficient. Whole-sido travel areas such as 서울 전체 may show policies with explicit localities inside that sido only.

endpoints.dbModePolicySlugBehavior: When policySlug is present, create the trip and link trip_policies; unknown policySlug returns 404 Policy not found.
endpoints.durationDaysBehavior: Optional durationDays defaults to 3, accepts 2 through 7, controls trips.end_date and generated trip_days when startDate/endDate are absent.
endpoints.participantCountBehavior: Optional legacy participantCount defaults to 1, accepts 1 through 10, and is stored as planned party size separate from the real member/invite list. Current /trips/new UI omits this field; actual participant display uses people.
endpoints.dateRangeBehavior: Optional startDate/endDate must be provided together, accept 2 through 7 days inclusive, override durationDays, and control trips.start_date/end_date plus generated trip_days.date.
endpoints.dbModeRecommendationBehavior: The returned recommendedPolicies follows strict municipality/city matching; province-only 광역 matches are excluded except explicit localities inside whole-sido travel areas.
endpoints.travelAreaIdBehavior: Valid static or dynamic policy-region travelAreaId resolves to backend travel area, stores trips.travel_area_id, and uses the travel-area display name as trips.region. Invalid travelAreaId returns 400 Travel area not found.
endpoints.dbModeCreateDaysBehavior: Creates Trip, owner membership, date-based trip_days, optional trip_policies link, and returns empty day arrays for newly created trips; does not generate auto-course places, trip_places, or trip_recommendations during create.

endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Requires owner/editor access, removes the trip-policy link idempotently, and returns added=false. Viewer access returns 403 Trip edit permission required.

Requires owner/editor access, stores trips.status, and returns the updated Trip. Accepts both confirmed and draft. The frontend trip list displays draft/confirmed status without an inline confirmation panel; the detail page can cancel confirmation by sending draft. Viewer access returns 403 Trip edit permission required.

endpoints.conflictBehavior: 409 Trip has changed. Refresh before saving. when expectedRevision is stale.
endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Requires owner/editor access, atomically compares and increments trips.revision, inserts trip_places, and returns the updated Trip. Viewer access returns 403 Trip edit permission required.

endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Requires owner/editor access, atomically compares and increments trips.revision, updates editable trip_places fields, and returns the updated Trip. Viewer access returns 403 Trip edit permission required.

Requires owner/editor access, atomically compares and increments trips.revision, updates trip_places.trip_day_id when day changes, normalizes affected trip_places.order_num values to consecutive 1-based positions, and returns the updated Trip. Viewer access returns 403 Trip edit permission required.

Authenticated trip members can search Kakao Local places for selection. The endpoint returns candidate metadata only and does not mutate itinerary data; saving still uses POST /api/trips/{tripId}/days/{dayNumber}/places with expectedRevision.

Returns additional place candidates for the trip, excluding places already in the itinerary. Kakao-backed candidates include official Local API map metadata such as categoryName, phone, address, coordinates, and placeUrl when available, and use sourceType=freshCandidate. New trip creation does not seed saved summaries; sourceType=savedSummary is reserved for legacy rows or future explicit recommendation-persistence flows.

endpoints.invitedMeaning: true when a valid invite token exists or the current request created/confirmed one
endpoints.roleBehavior: POST /api/trips/{tripId}/invite accepts optional viewer/editor role and defaults to editor

endpoints.dbModeBehavior: Owner-only. Ensures an active invite link, attempts SMTP delivery with a schedule-detail-safe email body, and returns a fallback invite link when SMTP is not configured or delivery fails.

Requires bearer auth, marks trip_invites.accepted_at, inserts trip_members idempotently with the invite role, returns alreadyMember=true without downgrading existing members, and rejects new members with 409 Trip participant limit reached when actual owner/member participants already total 10.
Lists users for admins only. Supports q, onboardingCompleted, limit, and offset. User role is exposed as user/admin.

Updates editable admin user fields only. preferredRegions remains the legacy admin comma-separated string shape, but is normalized against the same 17-sido max-3 rule as the public profile API; blank clears to null and invalid/4+ regions return 422. Email, password, removed profile/contact fields, and social accounts are not editable. Self-demotion and final-admin removal return 409.
Lists active and hidden policies for admins, sorted by policies.updated_at desc.
Creates an internal policy. sourceType, match, label, and tag are rejected. requirements are stored in policies.target_condition and documents replace policy_documents rows.
Updates normalized policy save fields. slug, sourceType, match, label, and tag are rejected. Editing an external policy sets adminOverrideEnabled=true.
Admin-only read endpoint. Summarizes external_source_records and promoted policies by generic source category without starting collection jobs or exposing source-specific controls.
